title: Cache issues on v3: inconsistent answers after a retrieval settings change
description: Customer reports cache issues. Confirmed version v3. Team G owns the response cache.

supplied: Issue description: 'Cache issues in v1 of the application' (corrected to v3 on confirmation)

resolution.root_cause: v3 response cache (Team G) served answers cached before a Tune/retrieval settings change; invalidate_on_tune_change was not enabled, so stale entries were returned for some queries while others were correct. Per CARD-007.
resolution.symptoms: Customer on v3 saw inconsistent answers: some queries returned old-style answers after a retrieval settings change, while other queries were correct at the same time. Reported as 'cache issues'.
resolution.detection_method: Matched to approved CARD-007: g.cache hit with no q.invocation for the trace, and b.config_change shortly before. Customer trace evidence was not supplied in this session; confirmation is per CARD-007 and team resolution.
resolution.logs_to_check: g.cache (hit_or_miss, trace_id); b.config_change (timestamp, tenant, flag); q.invocation (absent on cache hit); g.retrieval (top_k_effective)

fix.details: Purged the tenant's response cache and set rag.cache.invalidate_on_tune_change=true (per CARD-007).

resolution.pattern: Response cache not invalidated after a Tune change (CARD-007 pattern)
